title: Jamie Burkart portfolio production readiness
objective: Make the portfolio clear, inspectable, public-safe, application-ready, and production-safe without overstating Jamie's role or exposing protected material.
hard_constraints: Do not publish private source material, raw transcripts, private correspondence, legal-review material, stakeholder lists, credentials, or private records.
Do not strengthen ownership, causality, authority, scale, or current-status claims beyond the knowledge bank.
Preserve collective credit and collaborator-sensitive guardrails.
Do not display Jamie's phone number in website HTML; it may remain in the approved resume PDF.
Do not represent Source-Backed Team Memory as finished production SaaS or automated trust.
Do not deploy to production or enable indexing without Jamie's explicit approval of the exact candidate.

evals.title: Two-minute application comprehension
procedure: Give three blind judges no context beyond the candidate URLs.
Allow each judge two minutes of reading.
Ask each judge to identify Jamie's target role, central value, three proof examples, and the next action they would take.
pass_criteria: At least two of three judges identify Technical Project Manager, Product Operations, or Implementation as the role family.
At least two of three judges describe the central promise as creating operating structure from ambiguous work.
At least two of three judges name three accurate project proofs without inventing government employment, official authority, or solo policy causality.
Median score is 4.
evals.remediation_hint: Improve first-viewport positioning, proof hierarchy, and application-path links before adding more copy.

evals.title: Inspectable evidence on lead work
inputs: FairRentNYC case study including the Let NYC Dance participation sequence
procedure: Inventory visible figures, screenshots, diagrams, downloads, and public artifacts.
Verify each artifact's caption, provenance, alt text, consent status, and relation to a claim.
Have a blind judge explain what each artifact proves.
pass_criteria: Each lead page contains at least one genuine inspectable artifact, not only a styled descriptive card.
Every visual has useful alt text, a caption, a source or ownership note, and public-safety approval.

The FairRentNYC sequence makes the relationship among shared campaign infrastructure, coalition facilitation, and collective public participation legible without treating images as proof of exact remarks, attendance, endorsement, or sole causation.
The homepage or Technical Operations page links to at least three inspectable proof objects.
A judge can connect each artifact to a specific action, outcome, or operating capability.
evals.remediation_hint: Curate a small set of public-safe artifacts before adding additional case-study prose.

evals.title: Role-fit claims trace to projects and outcomes
procedure: Review each capability section.
Trace the capability to a named project, Jamie's action, an artifact or observable outcome, and a deeper link.
pass_criteria: Every primary capability has a project, action, evidence, and destination link.
Generic descriptions of desired job duties do not substitute for proof.
The page supports at least three common application narratives without becoming employer-specific.
evals.remediation_hint: Replace generic capability language with compact project-action-result rows.

evals.title: Voice, compression, and reading burden
procedure: Judge the copy for warmth, precision, civic and relational awareness, structural clarity, and claim discipline.
Identify repeated claims, internal editorial scaffolding, and sections that explain what an artifact could show instead of showing it.
pass_criteria: Each lead page establishes context, Jamie's action, and outcome within the first 250 words.
No adjacent sections repeat the same central claim without adding evidence or consequence.
Public copy sounds warm and precise rather than corporate, defensive, or overqualified.
Governance language supports trust without dominating the hiring narrative.
evals.remediation_hint: Let artifacts carry proof, shorten repeated explanation, and move detailed governance to concise scope notes.

evals.title: Claim governance and public safety
procedure: Run knowledge-bank, citation, and public-safety checks.
Trace every metric-bearing or strong claim to an approved proof record.
Review careful claims for contribution, stewardship, collective credit, and protected boundaries.
pass_criteria: All deterministic claim and public-safety checks pass.
Every strong public claim resolves to an approved proof record and source basis.
No public page strengthens ownership, causality, authority, scale, or current status.
No protected source material or unapproved collaborator material is published.
evals.remediation_hint: Soften or remove the public projection; never manufacture a stronger proof.

evals.title: Resume artifact readiness
procedure: Extract resume text and render every page.
Check links, page count, clipping, text density, role positioning, phone policy, and credential wording.
pass_criteria: The PDF is two pages or fewer, machine-readable, visually intact, and uses the approved phone number.
Phone is absent from website HTML.
Portfolio, email, LinkedIn, GitHub, and cited public links resolve correctly.
The top third communicates role, value, and strongest relevant proof.
AI Evals coursework is framed as professional development, not instructor affiliation or certification authority.
evals.remediation_hint: Fix the approved artifact or its delivery path without exposing phone data in HTML.

evals.title: CTA labels match their actions
procedure: Inventory CTA labels, hrefs, download attributes, and final destinations.
Exercise primary application and contact paths.
pass_criteria: A CTA labeled Download resume points to the PDF and initiates or clearly reaches a PDF download.
A CTA pointing to the resume HTML page is labeled View resume or equivalent.
Email, contact, work, case-study, and tag-filter actions have truthful labels and no dead ends.
All primary actions are reachable by keyboard.
evals.remediation_hint: Change the label or destination so the visible promise matches the resulting action.

evals.title: Indexing, canonical, and sitemap consistency
procedure: Check headers and metadata for every canonical route in staging and production mode.
Compare robots directives, sitemap membership, canonical URLs, and PDF behavior.
pass_criteria: Staging disallows crawling and emits noindex, nofollow headers.
Production HTML routes intended for discovery are indexable and canonicalize to jamieburk.art.
The resume HTML page is not simultaneously present in the sitemap and blocked by an X-Robots-Tag header.
The phone-bearing resume PDF remains noindex unless Jamie explicitly changes that policy.
The sitemap contains no route blocked from indexing and no staging URL.
evals.remediation_hint: Align route-specific headers, metadata, and sitemap membership before cutover.

evals.title: Build, route, and runtime integrity
procedure: Run npm check, staging preflight, and production preflight serially.
Build and run the production Docker image.
Smoke every canonical route, health endpoint, robots file, sitemap, and resume PDF.
Inspect browser console output.
pass_criteria: All repository and environment preflights pass.
The production Docker image builds and runs as a non-root user.
Every canonical route returns the expected success status and content type.
No uncaught browser-console errors appear on primary routes.
evals.remediation_hint: Fix the smallest failing contract and re-run the complete deterministic suite serially.

evals.title: Responsive and accessible use
inputs: all canonical routes at 360, 375, 768, and 1280 pixel widths
procedure: Capture responsive screenshots and measure document overflow.
Test landmarks, heading order, keyboard focus, link purpose, contrast, reduced motion, and image alternatives.
pass_criteria: No canonical route has horizontal page overflow at supported widths.
No text, navigation, or CTA overlaps or clips.
Keyboard users can reach and identify every primary action.
There are no critical accessibility violations.
Every meaningful image has useful alternative text and decorative images are ignored appropriately.
evals.remediation_hint: Fix the shared component or responsive constraint causing the broadest failure first.

evals.title: Production cutover preserves the public system
procedure: Verify the production app, domains, TLS, build arguments, runtime environment, redirect behavior, and rollback target.
Run post-deploy smoke tests against the public domains.
pass_criteria: jamieburk.art serves the reviewed portfolio candidate over TLS.
www redirects once to the canonical apex URL.
npr.jamieburk.art remains available and is not unintentionally overwritten.
Production health reports the production URL and indexable state.
A documented rollback can restore the prior routing or release.
evals.remediation_hint: Treat cutover as a bounded release with explicit routing, exact commit, smoke tests, and rollback.

evals.title: Approval and launch ledger is authoritative
procedure: Reconcile approvals and blockers into one current go or no-go record.
Ask Jamie to approve the exact candidate commit, public contact path, resume artifact, metrics, and new collaborator-sensitive artifacts.
pass_criteria: The approval register and launch ledger do not contradict each other.

Every new screenshot, photograph, quote, credit, or collaborator-sensitive artifact has recorded approval; the designated portfolio-album authorization remains destination-bound and excludes private metadata.
Jamie explicitly approves the exact production candidate and indexing state.
evals.remediation_hint: Stop and request human review; an LLM cannot satisfy this gate.

evals.title: AI and source-backed memory claims are demonstrated and bounded
procedure: Verify the course-completion evidence and wording.
Inspect one synthetic or public-safe worked example of the Known, Open, Protected method.
pass_criteria: Course completion is visible and accurately attributed as professional development.
The lab includes one inspectable public-safe or synthetic worked example.
The lab uses the exact approved metadata-stripped collective working-map photograph with descriptive alt text, an NYC Artist Coalition courtesy credit, and a recorded interpretation limit.
The page does not imply production SaaS, automated trust, client delivery, or access to private archives.
evals.remediation_hint: Show a bounded example and preserve the method's human-review and privacy limits.

evals.title: Chad Lens professional legibility
evals.source_basis: Public-safe synthesis of Chad Berkowitz's February and June 2026 resume-review guidance. The private review files are not part of the eval bundle or public repository.
procedure: Give three blind judges the rendered candidate and no implementation discussion: one human-resources gatekeeper, one public-sector generalist, and one technical delivery leader.
Allow each judge ninety seconds for the homepage, Technical Operations page, and resume, followed by a scan of the three lead case studies.
Ask each judge to state Jamie's target role and added value, then identify the actor, action, purpose, and usable result in each lead project.

Ask each judge to flag unexplained acronyms, specialist terms, symbols, tool lists without Jamie's relationship to them, weak verbs that understate the role, and language that overstates ownership or causality.
Require each judge to cite visible wording for every finding and distinguish a consequential comprehension failure from a minor editorial preference.
pass_criteria: All three judges identify Jamie as the actor and accurately describe his target role and added value without decoding specialist language.
Within the first 150 words of each lead project, a judge can identify what the project or organization is, what Jamie did, toward what end, and what became usable or observably changed.
At least 90 percent of sampled proof statements make actor, action, purpose, and usable result legible in the statement or immediate context.
No unexplained acronym, uncommon symbol, specialist term, or tool-only list creates a consequential comprehension failure for the human-resources or public-sector judge.
Contribution verbs neither hide Jamie's documented stewardship, facilitation, coordination, analysis, and implementation nor convert collective outcomes into solo ownership or causality.
The median score across the three judges is 4, and no judge scores below 3.
evals.remediation_hint: Reduce the reader's burden: name Jamie's action, the work's purpose, and the usable result in familiar language; strengthen a weak contribution verb only as far as the knowledge bank supports.

evals.title: Prof. Margaret Morse lens: inhabited systems
evals.source_basis: Public-safe synthesis grounded in contemporaneous reporting on Open House and protected UCSC educational records reviewed for rubric design only. The raw records, private correspondence, and unapproved testimonial text are excluded from the repository and public site.
inputs: FairRentNYC / NYC Artist Coalition case study
public-safe source note for the Open House article
procedure: Give three fresh judges the rendered candidate and no implementation discussion.
Ask whether the portfolio reduces Jamie to organizational utility or preserves a visible threshold where artistic, civic, technical, and social practices remain connected.

Ask each judge to trace at least three current practices to evidence of experimentation, hospitality, atmosphere or place, participation, attention, documentation, embodiment, care, or the ways people inhabit systems.
Verify that the lineage is legible within two clicks of the homepage and supports, rather than obscures, the target professional role.

Audit collective credit, participant privacy, protected educational records, and testimonial use; reject romanticized vulnerability, raw third-party article republication, or unapproved private-source projection.
pass_criteria: A visible surface within two clicks of the homepage connects the artistic, civic, technical, and social dimensions of Jamie's practice without turning the portfolio into an artist biography.
At least three public-safe project continuities show how experimentation, participation, attention, documentation, care, place, or hospitality shape the operating systems Jamie builds.
Readers can explain why Jamie's systems differ from conventional administration: people must be able to inhabit, influence, remember, and continue them.

Collective work remains collectively credited, participant privacy is preserved, the raw Open House article is not reproduced in the review packet, and no protected educational record, private correspondence, or unapproved testimonial is quoted or projected.
The median score across three judges is 4, and no judge scores below 3.
evidence_required: three independent Margaret Morse Lens scorecards
evals.remediation_hint: Restore one concise, evidence-backed threshold where experimentation, participation, attention, place, and care explain the operating practice; do not publish private praise to manufacture authority.

evals.title: Prof. Warren Sack lens: recursive social systems
evals.source_basis: Public-safe synthesis of Jamie's public project record and protected UCSC educational records reviewed for rubric design only. Dated coursework remains contextual lineage, not public proof of present proficiency, production deployment, disciplinary invention, or sole authorship.
procedure: Give three fresh judges the rendered candidate and no implementation discussion.
Ask each judge to reconstruct Jamie's recurring sequence: observe relationships, model a system, prototype an interface, test it through social or collective use, and document a handoff.

Require each judge to trace the sequence through at least three current public-safe projects and identify where recursive systems thinking, social structure, information architecture, or prototype-to-public-system continuity is visible.
Verify that one public surface names the method plainly while project pages supply inspectable proof rather than abstract systems language alone.

Audit the distinction between dated coursework and present role evidence; reject invention of structural equivalence, peer-reviewed research, production deployment, sole authorship, and current Max/Jitter proficiency.
pass_criteria: At least three current public-safe projects make the observation-to-model-to-interface-to-social-use-to-documentation sequence reconstructable.
One visible surface within two clicks of the homepage states the recursive method in plain language and links to project evidence.
Readers can connect social structure and information architecture to usable interfaces, collective participation, learning, and handoffs rather than seeing disconnected outputs or a tool list.

Dated coursework appears only as bounded lineage or remains held in the knowledge bank; the public site does not claim disciplinary invention, peer-reviewed research, production deployment, sole authorship, or current Max/Jitter proficiency from protected records.
The median score across three judges is 4, and no judge scores below 3.
evidence_required: three independent Warren Sack Lens scorecards
evals.remediation_hint: Name the recurring systems sequence once, then let three bounded project examples show how relationship models become interfaces, collective use, learning, and durable handoffs.

evals.title: Public engagement pathway is legible, bounded, and source-independent
evals.source_basis: Jamie's self-authored public offer and existing approved public portfolio evidence. Any private relationship, correspondence, transcript, negotiation, draft agreement, or expression of interest is excluded from the candidate and cannot establish demand.
procedure: Run the deterministic RFC 0012 evaluator before any rendered or model-based review.
Give three fresh readers the rendered candidate without its implementation discussion: one role-seeking hiring reader, one public-sector operating leader, and one prospective consulting buyer.
Ask each reader to distinguish the route for a salaried or embedded role from the route for scoped work, then choose the smallest fitting next step for three supplied needs.

Ask each reader what clicking the primary call to action will do, what each engagement can produce, what requires a new agreement, and whether the page implies an existing client, demand, endorsement, price, or result.
Audit every factual and commercial claim for public source support, pricing approval, private-source independence, truthful action labels, collective credit, and explicit human gates.
pass_criteria: All three readers can distinguish role interest from scoped consulting without concluding that consulting has replaced Jamie's interest in embedded or salaried work.

All three readers can identify the focused working session, knowledge operations diagnostic, and implementation or fractional operations path and explain the buyer decision and bounded outcome for each.
Every transition requires a separate agreement on scope, compensation, timing, authority, and outputs; no conversation or earlier rung implies automatic continuation.
The public offer remains true and supportable after excluding every private relationship, expression of interest, correspondence item, transcript, negotiation, and draft agreement.
The candidate makes no unsupported claim of client adoption, endorsement, current paid engagement, market demand, or measured client result.
The primary call to action truthfully reaches the existing contact interaction and does not imply booking, payment, acceptance, or a contract.
No exact public fee appears without Jamie's approval of the number, currency, unit, effective date, and conditions against the exact candidate.
The first version adds no top-level navigation item, checkout, payment processing, scheduling integration, client portal, private-document browser, or new runtime dependency.
The median reader score is 4, no reader scores below 3, and every deterministic hard gate passes.
evals.remediation_hint: Reduce the path to one canonical Contact surface, lead each option with the buyer's decision and bounded outcome, and remove any wording whose truth depends on a private source or unapproved commercial term.
